_comment: Repo migration 2026-05-18: the apps/command-center Next.js app
The Vercel project that was previously rooted at apps/command-center
in this repo (CEO-Agent) now has no app to build — every push has
been erroring with 'specified Root Directory apps/command-center
does not exist'. ignoreCommand returns 0 unconditionally, which
tells Vercel to SKIP the build entirely. No more red error rows
in the deployments dashboard for commits to this repo.
ignoreCommand: echo 'apps/command-center extracted to CC90210/oasis-command-center; skipping build' && exit 0
